anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel Raman spectrum with four vertically offset curves and an in-panel legend at upper right. The interior labels 'D' and 'G' mark Raman bands, not panel labels. Full-figure crop was retained because the figure contains only this one panel.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: No meaningful curve-curve occlusion is present; all four spectra remain visually separable across the plot width.
response.interpretation_notes: Four solid Raman spectra are vertically offset and traced across the full visible main plot. The in-plot D and G text labels are annotations, not curves.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
